experiment_data.hypothesis: An XGBoost/LightGBM entity-level verifier trained on agreement_count, VC, LP features can predict whether entity candidates are in gold annotations, enabling post-hoc filtering or score-weighted construction that improves over greedy baseline, with cross-dataset generalization from CoNLL+SciERC to FewNERD+WNUT.
